## Summary

Describe the functional change and why it is required.

## Risk

- [ ] Read-only behavior only
- [ ] Quest write behavior changed
- [ ] Authentication or authorization behavior changed
- [ ] UI/XAML behavior changed
- [ ] Packaging, signing, or release behavior changed

## Validation

- [ ] Python static validation passed
- [ ] Runtime source audit passed
- [ ] PowerShell static/mock validation passed
- [ ] WPF validation completed where applicable
- [ ] Live Quest validation completed where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or unsanitized logs are included

## Rollback

Describe how this change can be reverted or which prior release remains available.
